title: Optimize Segmentation Pipeline to Hit IoU ≥ 0.55
description: A multi-class semantic segmentation model sits at IoU=0.21. You have exactly 5 more epochs to reach IoU≥0.55. Tune the loss function and LR scheduler together.

initial_state.architecture_summary: U-Net: Encoder(ResNet50) -> BottleNeck(1024) -> Decoder(4x UpConv) -> Conv2d(64, num_classes=5). Loss: CrossEntropyLoss (unweighted). LR: 0.001 (constant).
training_logs: Plateau detected. IoU improvement slowing. Target: 0.55 in 5 more epochs.

dice_loss_only.message: ✅ Dice loss applied. Better at handling class imbalance. IoU improving but won't reach 0.55 without a scheduler. Add add_lr_scheduler.
training_logs: Dice loss helping with class overlap. Needs LR scheduling to push further.

focal_loss_only.message: ✅ Focal loss applied. Focusing on hard examples. IoU improving. Combine with add_lr_scheduler to reach target.
training_logs: Focal loss reducing background dominance. Needs LR boost.

cosine_scheduler_only.message: ⚠️ CosineAnnealing LR applied. Modest improvement. CrossEntropy alone is limiting IoU — change the loss function too.
training_logs: Scheduler helping but loss function limiting segmentation quality.

dice_and_cosine.message: 🏆 Excellent! Dice loss + CosineAnnealingLR hit the target. mIoU=0.57 ≥ 0.55!

focal_and_cosine.message: 🏆 Excellent! Focal loss + CosineAnnealingLR hit the target. mIoU=0.56 ≥ 0.55!

dice_and_step_scheduler.message: ⚠️ Dice loss + StepLR improved IoU to 0.48 — close but not enough. Try CosineAnnealingLR for smoother decay.
training_logs: Epoch 8  | train_loss=0.5921 | val_loss=0.6523 | mIoU=0.41  LR step decay
Close but under target 0.55. StepLR too abrupt for this task.

crossentropy_and_scheduler.message: ⚠️ CrossEntropy + scheduler improved things but not enough. CrossEntropy struggles with class imbalance in segmentation. Switch to Dice or Focal loss.
training_logs: Plateau at 0.38. CrossEntropy not suitable for multi-class segmentation.

modify_hyperparameters.message: ⚠️ Hyperparameter tweaks alone won't close the gap. Focus on the loss function and LR scheduler combination.
training_logs: Marginal change. Still well below target.

add_dropout.message: ⚠️ Dropout can slightly hurt segmentation models at inference. Focus on loss function and scheduler.
training_logs: Dropout added slight noise. No real improvement.

default.message: ⚠️ Unknown action. For segmentation: use change_loss_function (Dice or Focal) AND add_lr_scheduler (cosine).
training_logs: No meaningful change. IoU still at 0.21.
